musicOnsetQualification: Acoustic onset analysis; not claimed downbeats or subjective listening
copyPolicy: Opening and ending carry the tagline; no oversized feature headings in the core interaction
nativeMotionRequirement: Continuous WindowServer capture, preserving source presentation-layer animation. Static view snapshots cannot qualify.
retirement: Observed native window withdrawal determines visibility; no invented pause-to-hide timing.
runtime_change: 34s accommodates the actual control actions and withdrawal at original speed.
nativeBlankTransitionPolicy: Only final sustained uniform source frames become transparent; earlier blank lyric-transition frames retain their native card.
retiredDesktopHold: A source passage may end after sustained actual withdrawal; the compositor continues the empty desktop, without extending or inventing source motion.
